description.value: Pizza 64 is a BC pizza chain with a Pitt Meadows location along McMyn Road, offering both takeout and delivery. The restaurant is a franchise operation with a loyalty rewards program, making it a reliable stop in the Pitt Meadows area for a quick, filling meal. Touring cyclists passing through this suburban community will find it a convenient refuel option.
